dialogue: Ma fille, j'ai lu ton journal intime-là dêh.
Maman ! C'est mes secrets ça dêh !
Ya fohi. J'ai corrigé les fautes. Et ton copain-là, je l'ai barré.
jeu: Nobody walks; both stay in their places for the whole video. The mother lifts the open diary slightly and announces it calmly, face three-quarters to the camera. The daughter, hands on her hips, protests loudly. The mother turns the diary toward the camera to show red marks on the page and says her line with a teacher's satisfied nod, her face clearly visible.
chute: The daughter's hands drop from her hips and her mouth falls wide open. The camera slowly pushes in to a close-up of the outraged daughter's devastated face looking into the camera.
gag_legende: LE COPAIN QUAND IL VA APPRENDRE ÇA :
mecanisme: décalage absurde : la mère corrige le journal comme une copie + double sanction
